name: playwright-qa-agent
description: Playwright + TypeScript test framework for QA teams

scripts.pretest: node -e "for (const d of ['allure-results', 'playwright/.auth/run-accounts']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.pretest:sanity: node -e "for (const d of ['allure-results', 'playwright/.auth/run-accounts']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.report:build: node support/secret-scan.mjs redact && allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report --name "Toolshop UI tests" && node support/secret-scan.mjs check
scripts.report: npm run report:build && allure open allure-report
